# Getting help

| I need to…                   | Where to go                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Ask a question or get advice | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/lncrawl/lightnovel-crawler/discussions)                                 |
| Report a bug                 | [Bug Report issue](https://github.com/lncrawl/lightnovel-crawler/issues/new?template=1_bug_report.md)           |
| Report a broken source       | [Source Not Working issue](https://github.com/lncrawl/lightnovel-crawler/issues/new?template=2_source_issue.md) |
| Request a new source         | [New Source Request issue](https://github.com/lncrawl/lightnovel-crawler/issues/new?template=3_new_source.md)   |
| Report a security issue      | [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) — do not open a public issue                                                  |

For installation instructions and the CLI reference, see the [README](../README.md). The full list of supported sources is in [SOURCES.md](../SOURCES.md).
